title: Tidewater by Del Webb Estero FL: Who Can Actually Live in Your Home? 2026
excerpt: At Tidewater, the age rule is not the federal 80/20 standard almost every 55+ community guide quotes. The community's own recorded declaration requires at least one occupant 55 or older in every occupied home, bars anyone under 19 from living there, and is locked for 30 years by a Lee County ordinance.
